[element-std-org-group]
=== `<std-org-group>` Standards Organization Group

A grouping element to hold the name and location information (<<element-std-org,`<std-org>`>>) for several standards organizations associated with producing/adopting a standard.

* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>

    <state>NY</state>

    <uri>https://www.asme.org/</uri></std-org-loc>

    <postal-code>20005</postal-code>
